title: CHAPTER 10: GENERAL KNOWLEDGE TOPICS FOR MPSC/SI EXAM

blocks.content: The following constitutional provisions are important for MPSC and SI exams as they relate to Maharashtra's governance:

cells: States having bicameral legislature (Maharashtra has both Vidhan Sabha and Vidhan Parishad)
Public Service Commissions for States (basis for MPSC)
Panchayati Raj (73rd Amendment); Maharashtra implemented it in 1993
Special provision for Maharashtra and Gujarat; Development Boards for Vidarbha, Marathwada, and rest of Maharashtra
Emergency provisions; Governor's Rule (356) relevant to Maharashtra history

blocks.content: Article 371(2) provides that the President may, by order, make provisions with respect to equitable opportunities and facilities to people belonging to Vidarbha, Marathwada, and the rest of Maharashtra in the matter of:

items: Public services and posts in connection with the affairs of the State
Technical Education and Vocational Training
Development expenditure from Consolidated Fund

blocks.content: As a result, three separate Development Boards are established: Vidarbha Development Board, Marathwada Development Board, and Maharashtra (Rest) Development Board.
10.2 Important Acts and Laws Relevant to Maharashtra SI Exam

cells: Governs Maharashtra Police; duties, powers, and conduct of police
Procedure for investigation, trial; replaced by BNSS 2023
Substantive criminal law; replaced by BNS (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita) 2023
Rules of evidence; replaced by BSA (Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam) 2023
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
Child sexual abuse; SI must know provisions
Scheduled Castes and Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
Protection for SC/ST communities; important for police
Road traffic regulations; important for traffic police

blocks.content: The Union Government replaced the three principal criminal laws with new Codes, effective July 1, 2024. These are important for all police and law-related exams:

cells: Replaced IPC (Indian Penal Code) 1860; 358 sections (vs 511 in IPC)

blocks.content: Key Changes in New Criminal Laws

items: BNSS introduced 90-day timeline for completion of investigation in serious offenses.
BNS includes organized crime and terrorism provisions (not in original IPC).
Sedition (IPC Section 124A) has been replaced by Section 152 of BNS (acts endangering sovereignty).
Zero FIR: Can be registered at any police station; transferred to appropriate jurisdiction later.
e-FIR: Online FIR registration made mandatory for certain offences.
Trial in absentia: Courts can proceed against fugitive accused.
BNSS mandates audio-video recording of evidence collection and search-seizure proceedings.

blocks.content: MPSC examinations and SI exams include General Mental Ability sections. Key topics include:

items: Number Series, Letter Series, Coding-Decoding
Logical Reasoning: Syllogisms, Blood Relations, Direction Sense
Data Interpretation: Tables, Bar Graphs, Pie Charts, Line Graphs
Analogies and Odd One Out
Spatial Reasoning: Mirrors, Paper Folding, Venn Diagrams
Mathematical Ability: Percentage, Ratio, Speed-Distance, Work-Time, Simple Interest, Compound Interest

blocks.content: For SI and MPSC exams, Marathi language comprehension and grammar are tested. Key areas:

items: Sandhi (Conjunction of words) – Swar Sandhi, Vyanjan Sandhi, Visarga Sandhi
Samaas (Compound words) – Tatpurusha, Bahuvrihi, Dvandva, Avyayibhav
Viramchinha (Punctuation marks) – their correct usage
Vachane (Singular-Plural) and Ling (Gender)
Krutipadanche Prayog – Kartari, Karmani, Bhave Prayog
Vakyaprachaar – Saadhya, Saapeksh, Mishrit vakya
Prayogik Shabd (Synonyms, Antonyms in Marathi)
Mhani ani Vakprachaar (Proverbs and phrases in Marathi)
Tenses – all 12 tenses with correct usage
Active and Passive Voice
Direct and Indirect Speech
Articles (a, an, the) – correct usage
Subject-Verb Agreement
Prepositions – common errors
Comprehension passages
Vocabulary – Synonyms, Antonyms, One-Word Substitutions
Idioms and Phrases
